name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 5 visits over 72 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.0 days starting 2026-01-01, at wavelengths from 0.74 to 4.88 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
